dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Three prominent 'O' and 'C' shaped silver-colored structures are visible on the dorsal surface. The largest annulus on the mid-left exhibits a thick, high-contrast perimeter with jagged outer edges and a dark, low-intensity interior. Two smaller, nearly closed rings in the upper-right quadrant show sharp gradient transitions from bright exterior to dark centers.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: High density of small, isolated, high-intensity silver pixel clusters (approx. 5-10 pixels each) lacking internal gradients, primarily concentrated in the interstitial spaces between the larger macro-annuli on the left dorsal flank.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of the three most prominent dorsal macro-annuli form a scalene triangle with the longest side extending from the top-right cluster to the large mid-left annulus.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of fine, linear high-intensity white filaments at the posterior-most extremity, consistent with the visual signature of whiskers/vibrissae.
